expected_behavior: The vessel identifier is the literal placeholder 'MV TBN' (to-be-named) with only a tentative dwt range and open area; the parser must extract it as vessel_name 'MV TBN' (a valid identifier when explicitly written) but must NOT invent particulars — built, flag and IMO stay null, and the hedged dwt must be interpreted not confirmed, never a fabricated real vessel.

input.subject: TBN nominated - W.Med / abt 35k dwt Handy
input.body:
Dear Sirs,

For below cargo we intend to nominate a TBN, pls work on indication basis:

MV TBN (owners to nominate on fixing)
abt 35,000 dwt Handysize, gearless
Open W.Med, prompt / first half June

Owners reserve right to substitute with sister vessel of similar size/spec.
Full particulars + name to follow on firm.

Pls indicate freight idea bss above.

Brgds,
Lorenzo
